newsitem.title: PERU: Fourth teen dies after Peru concert chaos.
newsitem.headline: Fourth teen dies after Peru concert chaos.

text.p: The death toll from an open-air concert in Lima rose to four on Friday when a 16-year-old girl died from brain damage caused by asphyxiation after being crushed in a crowd of salsa fans, officials said.

Another girl, 15, was in a coma as a result of the chaos at Tuesday night's concert, which was attended by more than 100,000 people. In addition to the four deaths, more than 100 spectators were injured in the hysteria and panic.
The deaths sparked outrage in Peru against both the concert organisers and Venezuelan teenage idol Servando y Florentino, who hurriedly left the country despite a government inquiry into the event.
